description: This is a Linux kernel driver source file for the 'PTM' (Packet Transfer Module) related to the 'UEIP' project, specifically implementing core functions for Danube, Amazon-SE, and AR9 platforms. It includes network device setup, interrupt handling, buffer management, and proc filesystem interfaces for a PTM driver.

methods.name: ltq_ptm_probe
methods.description: Initializes the driver, allocates resources, registers network devices, sets up IRQs, and starts the PTM chip.

methods.name: ltq_ptm_remove
methods.description: Cleans up resources, deregisters network devices, and stops the PTM chip.

methods.name: ptm_setup
methods.description: Configures a network device, sets MAC address, and NAPI.

methods.name: ptm_get_stats
methods.description: Returns network statistics for a device.

methods.name: ptm_open
methods.description: Starts the network device and enables NAPI.

methods.name: ptm_stop
methods.description: Stops the network device and disables NAPI.

methods.name: ptm_poll
methods.description: Polls for received packets on a given interface.

methods.name: ptm_napi_poll
methods.description: NAPI poll function for packet processing.

methods.name: ptm_hard_start_xmit
methods.description: Transmits a packet by setting up descriptors and signaling.

methods.name: ptm_ioctl
methods.description: Handles ioctl commands for MIB and configuration.

methods.name: ptm_tx_timeout
methods.description: Handles transmission timeout, disables IRQ, and wakes queue.

methods.name: adsl_led_flash
methods.description: Stub for LED flashing (empty implementation).

methods.name: alloc_skb_rx
methods.description: Allocates a socket buffer for receiving.

methods.name: get_skb_rx_pointer
methods.description: Retrieves socket buffer pointer from dataptr.

methods.name: get_tx_desc
methods.description: Gets a free transmit descriptor.

methods.name: mailbox_rx_irq_handler
methods.description: Handles received packet interrupt.

methods.name: mailbox_irq_handler
methods.description: Interrupt handler for mailbox IRQs.

methods.name: mailbox_signal
methods.description: Signals mailbox for TX or RX.

methods.name: do_ptm_tasklet
methods.description: Tasklet for deferred packet processing.

methods.name: dump_skb
methods.description: Debug function to dump skb contents.

methods.name: skb_swap
methods.description: Swaps MAC addresses and IP headers in skb for debugging.

methods.name: proc_file_create
methods.description: Creates proc filesystem entries.

methods.name: proc_file_delete
methods.description: Removes proc filesystem entries.

methods.name: proc_read_version
methods.description: Reads driver version info.

methods.name: proc_read_wanmib
methods.description: Reads WAN MIB statistics.

methods.name: proc_write_wanmib
methods.description: Writes WAN MIB configuration or clears stats.

methods.name: ifx_ptm_version
methods.description: Retrieves firmware version info.

methods.name: check_parameters
methods.description: Validates and adjusts driver parameters.

methods.name: init_priv_data
methods.description: Initializes private data structures and descriptors.

methods.name: clear_priv_data
methods.description: Frees allocated buffers and descriptors.

methods.name: init_tables
methods.description: Initializes hardware tables and registers.
